聖地牙哥動物園第2季:7
programme.desc: 聖地牙哥動物園第2季:非洲野豬泥巴浴.這集的聖地牙哥動物園中，首先登場的是非洲野豬，這種聰明的豬有能力全體一起共同決定事情，這集節目中，牠們將轉移棲息區；同樣需要轉移棲息區的還有索馬里鹿羚，因為牠們的族群數增加不少；另外，園裡正為一對遠東豹配對，結果順利產下一對幼崽；還有園內的赤樹袋鼠，去年生下一隻小寶寶，是全球唯一在人類照護下誕生的赤樹袋鼠；節目中另外一段特別主題是，一名員工前往澳洲協助無尾熊的田野研究，研究期間正好碰上澳洲發生叢林大火，他們果斷地把研究對全數象救出，大火撲滅後再把牠們重新野放

programme.title: 聖地牙哥動物園第2季:8
programme.desc: 聖地牙哥動物園第2季:狐?換菜色.在本集節目中，因為粉蜱數量短缺狐改吃老鼠，挑嘴的牠們願意接受嗎？兩隻黑犀牛即將第一次見面，但母犀牛似乎不太領情，保育員只好再想辦法讓牠們相見歡民眾通報有一隻念珠蜥蜴在路上逛大街，牠被送到動物園接受隔離檢查

programme.title: 聖地牙哥動物園第2季:9
programme.desc: 聖地牙哥動物園第2季:神奇的陸龜.在本集節目中，加拉巴哥象龜艾比蓋爾的右後腳受了輕傷，走起路來一拐一拐，獸醫和保育員打算為牠做全身電腦斷層掃描棕熊史考特和蒙大拿食慾大開，為冬天做好準備兩隻害羞的母毛冠鹿即將迎接新的公鹿加入，可望生下鹿寶寶命運多舛的無尾熊歐米奧終於迎來週歲，保育員特地為牠佈置驚喜

programme.title: 野地求生奇才:4
programme.desc: 野地求生奇才:動物智慧.非洲豹潛伏東非大裂谷，以智慧伏擊羚羊，把獵物拖上樹守住生機

programme.title: 野地寒冬:1
programme.desc: 野地寒冬:適應.寒冬見證了適者生存的道理，只有適應力超強的動物，才能挺過極度嚴寒的野地寒冬

programme.title: 野地寒冬:2
programme.desc: 野地寒冬:掠食.地球的寒冷地區進入冬季時，食物也變得匱乏，住在冰天雪地裡的動物，為了生存進化出各種掠食方式

programme.title: 野地寒冬:3
programme.desc: 野地寒冬:生存.地球上最寒冷地區的冬天，挑戰動物的體能和認知能力的極限，動物們必須利用體型力量和靈敏度通過考驗

programme.title: 野地寒冬:4
programme.desc: 野地寒冬:生命循環.地球上有八百萬種動植物，每個物種都有一股本能的驅動力，就是繁衍，並把基因特質傳遞給未來的世代

programme.title: 布朗克斯動物園第3季:5
programme.desc: 布朗克斯動物園第3季:螺角山羊寶寶出生.保育員意外在展示區的地上發現一隻幼齡的羅德里格斯狐蝠

programme.title: 野地刺客:1
programme.desc: 野地刺客:毒液.從常見的蜘蛛蜈蚣到罕見的毒蜥；從沙漠的蠍子到海裡的水母和魟魚，這些生物都有一項致命武器，那就是毒液

programme.title: 珍稀白獅王
programme.desc: 珍稀白獅王.白獅子很稀有，目前全世界僅存大約三百隻，而且全是人工飼養的世界上已經沒有野生白獅子了白獅子珍貴在於牠們並不是因為缺乏黑色素而變成白色，而是本身就有白色基因白獅子在野外生存並不容易，因為牠們全身都很白，缺乏一般獅子的保護色，因此不容易抓到獵物牠們全白的原因可能是因為在上一個冰河時代，非洲還是冰天雪地的時候，全身白反而是保護色白獅子本來已經絕種了但是兩個非洲獅子專家克里斯和傑克，在1970年代，無意間發現三隻小白獅之後，才延續了白獅的命運原來某些黃褐色獅子身上也還帶著白色遺傳因子如果兩隻黃褐色獅子身上都有白因子，那麼牠們交配時，有四分之一的機會會生下白獅子但是有白基因的獅子太少，這種情況很不容易發生不管怎麼他們找到的那三隻白獅子，在專家精心照料下，目前已經繁殖成三百多隻了

programme.title: 超狂釣手:5
programme.desc: 超狂釣手:小心獵頭族.本集節目中，超狂釣手來到婆羅洲尋找極為罕見的馬西亞魚

programme.title: 動物百分百第3季:5
programme.desc: 動物百分百第3季:人猿.猿類與人類的基因相似，但也面臨滅絕的危機，透過保育計畫，希望所有的猿類都能繼續成為地球的森林之人

programme.title: 動物求生高手第2季:4
programme.desc: 動物求生高手第2季:贏在起跑點.揭曉野地裡的最強爸媽，探究奇妙的育兒技巧和繁殖策略

programme.title: 自然怪事求解答:2
programme.desc: 自然怪事求解答:爬高樓的浣熊.你有想過為什麼浣熊會爬25層的高樓大廈嗎？為什麼一隻鴨媽媽會帶著76隻鴨寶寶？還有黑頭?為什麼要去餵金魚？

programme.title: 自然怪事求解答:3
programme.desc: 自然怪事求解答:小傢伙愛作怪.在猶他州大盆地沙漠，田野生物學家放了小牛屍體探索食腐動物行為，兩週後卻發現屍體人間蒸發

programme.title: 法蘭克的野生加州:4
programme.desc: 法蘭克的野生加州:海洋生物.法蘭克走訪加州著名的崎嶇海岸，這個地帶是海洋保護區，經常能看到許多海洋生物

programme.title: 野生王朝:1
programme.desc: 野生王朝:上.在非洲最荒涼的地方，動物各有一套獨特技巧及防衛措施，除了活下去，還要確保後代能長大到成年，這就是非洲平原上的動物要面對的宿命大象斑馬牛羚等草食動物無法避開掠食者，只能隨時保持警戒，肉食動物為了餵飽自己的寶寶也各出奇招，豺犬打團體戰；鬣狗除了吃腐肉，還靠耐力對獵物緊追不捨；獵豹靠速度捕捉獵物；而胡狼則見機行事，偷走別人的獵物，牠們都全力以赴，在充滿變數的非洲大地上尋找生機

programme.title: 野地的貓科:1
programme.desc: 野地的貓科:非洲.非洲是文明的發源地，住在這裡的動物超過兩百萬種，其中有十種是野地貓科動物，但這些兇猛的野地貓科遭受棲地破壞氣候變化及人類威脅，而被歸類為易危物種

programme.title: 熱血獸醫師第4季:10
programme.desc: 熱血獸醫師第4季:家的感覺.在這次的節目中，傑夫醫生要帶著他的團隊前往羅馬尼亞羅馬尼亞的流浪狗數量高居世界之冠，因此有嚴重的公共衛生問題2012年，一群野狗咬死一個小孩後，政府便展開大規模的滅狗行動，殺死了近十萬隻流浪狗傑夫認為撲殺並不能解決流浪狗問題只有推動絕育才能讓流浪狗逐漸減少問題是羅馬尼亞有很多低收入者他們不可能會花上一個月的收入，為自己的寵物絕育因此傑夫以一個流浪狗收容所為據點，提供平價的絕育服務他也找來當地獸醫，一起推廣為寵物絕育的觀念

programme.title: 動物軍火庫:2
programme.desc: 動物軍火庫:搏擊戰鬥.動物互毆博鬥的本領，在自然界的戰場，可能造成生與死的區別，野牛兜蟲蝦蛄鴕鳥銀背大猩猩都是高手

programme.title: 野性無窮盡:2
programme.desc: 野性無窮盡:短命.原創系列深入探索地球上非凡生物的驚人壽命，揭開生命長度的極限，帶大家認識大自然中的長壽紀錄保持者透過令人著迷的科學發現，節目探究為何有些物種能存活千百年，而另一些生命卻在短短數日內走向終結從決定壽命界限的遺傳機制，到影響生存條件的環境因素，我們將探索塑造生命長度的複雜平衡，畢竟在野外世界中，長壽是一場罕見的勝利野性無窮盡將人類自身的生命旅程，與地球上最長壽及最短命的生命體巧妙對照，引發對生命的思考

programme.title: 百變爬蟲箱:9
programme.desc: 百變爬蟲箱:第9集.朗妲和女兒梅根熱愛爬蟲類，家裡養了箭毒蛙變色龍守宮藍舌蜥等等這次她們委託康乃爾世界公司，幫她們的藍舌蜥珊咪做印尼主題的飼養箱製作團隊想出峇里島海灘與船隻，以及印度教廟宇雕刻的風格，讓牠們的藍舌蜥有美麗的地方棲息，並且加碼做第二個飼養箱，讓牠們的睫角守宮科米和奧麗芙也有溫暖的新家

programme.title: 狗狗101新把戲:11
programme.desc: 狗狗101新把戲:不再誤解.本集介紹一些最被人誤解的犬種，以及牠們真正的性情，包括英國比特鬥牛犬洛威拿犬德國牧羊犬杜賓犬秋田鬆獅犬和英國獒犬這幾種狗因為體格和保護慾等原因，往往被誤以為性情凶猛，或是個性冷淡不愛親人但其實只要投入關愛與適當的訓練，這些狗就能發揮真正的本性，成為人類的好伙伴，平反因為傳言或恐懼而產生的壞名聲

programme.title: 狗狗101新把戲:12
programme.desc: 狗狗101新把戲:留名歷史.在本集中，我們要探討狗被人類馴化的歷史以及牠們的來源主要介紹五大原始犬種，畜牧犬狼型犬視覺型獸獵犬指示犬和獒犬牠們各有各的特點，以及當初原始的培育目的，不過到了現代，育種的目的多半只是為了陪伴人類不管牠們的來源為何，有怎樣的技能，狗都已經成為人類生活中很重要的一部分，永遠伴隨我們左右

programme.desc: 百變爬蟲箱:第9集.朗妲和女兒梅根熱愛爬蟲類，家裡養了箭毒蛙變色龍守宮藍舌蜥等等這次她們委託康乃爾世界公司，幫她們的藍舌蜥珊咪做印尼主題的飼養箱製作團隊想出峇里島海灘與船隻，以及印度教廟宇雕刻的風格，讓牠們的藍舌蜥有美麗的地方棲息，並且加碼做第二個飼養箱，讓牠們的睫角守宮科米和奧麗芙也有溫暖的新家

programme.title: 法蘭克的野生加州:4
programme.desc: 法蘭克的野生加州:海洋生物.法蘭克走訪加州著名的崎嶇海岸，這個地帶是海洋保護區，經常能看到許多海洋生物

programme.title: 自然怪事求解答:6
programme.desc: 自然怪事求解答:僵屍蜘蛛.科羅拉多州氣象局的雷達上面出現一大團不明物體，氣象專家認為這不是天氣，應該是某種動物集體行動所造成的現象

programme.title: 自然怪事求解答:7
programme.desc: 自然怪事求解答:挾持人質的鯨魚.在南太平洋，一名鯨魚生物學家進行研究時，疑似被一頭大翅鯨攻擊，但事後研究，鯨魚其實是要拯救這名科學家

programme.title: 野性之海:1
programme.desc: 野性之海:顏色與偽裝.在東亞水域，生活在珊瑚礁的生物，靠色彩和偽裝求得一線生機，有些生物還會和其他生物組成互利的共生關係

programme.title: 狗狗101新把戲:11
programme.desc: 狗狗101新把戲:不再誤解.本集介紹一些最被人誤解的犬種，以及牠們真正的性情，包括英國比特鬥牛犬洛威拿犬德國牧羊犬杜賓犬秋田鬆獅犬和英國獒犬這幾種狗因為體格和保護慾等原因，往往被誤以為性情凶猛，或是個性冷淡不愛親人但其實只要投入關愛與適當的訓練，這些狗就能發揮真正的本性，成為人類的好伙伴，平反因為傳言或恐懼而產生的壞名聲

programme.title: 狗狗101新把戲:12
programme.desc: 狗狗101新把戲:留名歷史.在本集中，我們要探討狗被人類馴化的歷史以及牠們的來源主要介紹五大原始犬種，畜牧犬狼型犬視覺型獸獵犬指示犬和獒犬牠們各有各的特點，以及當初原始的培育目的，不過到了現代，育種的目的多半只是為了陪伴人類不管牠們的來源為何，有怎樣的技能，狗都已經成為人類生活中很重要的一部分，永遠伴隨我們左右

programme.title: 鱷魚拍檔這一家第2季:2
programme.desc: 鱷魚拍檔這一家第2季:與蟒蛇同游.本集中，羅伯特將嘗試第一次和網紋蟒一起游泳，這是澳洲動物園的創舉，也是他父親史帝夫從未做過的事網紋蟒是世上最長的蛇，當牠們咬住目標時，通常咬了就不會放開，然後以蠻力絞纏對方到窒息而死，因此頭一次和網紋蟒一起游泳，讓羅伯特不免有些緊張另外，澳洲動物園內有遼闊的袋鼠區，許多袋鼠都是孤兒，被人類由奶瓶餵養長大，因此不太害怕人類；園內的飼育員必須不眠不休地為小袋鼠餵奶，就像照顧人類嬰兒一樣這天動物醫院收到一隻受傷的楔尾鵰，牠甚至無法飛行，經過兩個多月的照顧和調養，泰瑞終於能將牠野放

programme.title: 管教惡貓第4季:6
programme.desc: 管教惡貓第4季:四處撒尿.小皮是一隻小腦發育不全的黑色獨眼貓，雖然牠的身體不良於行，跟牠同住的瑞德卻經常遭牠毒打，以至於瑞德經常在外流浪，而主人的室友也因為家裡不安寧而考慮搬家另一家人的貓咪秋天會到處尿尿，破壞了很多電器產品，他們甚至有貓尿物品墳場堆放被牠尿壞或除不掉尿騷味的物件情況嚴重到這家人考慮讓牠永遠待在戶外，可是他們家的後面就是山，有郊狼等野生動物，秋天待在戶外就有生命危險，傑克森要針對個別的問題，為他們管教惡貓

programme.title: 動物軍火庫:2
programme.desc: 動物軍火庫:搏擊戰鬥.動物互毆博鬥的本領，在自然界的戰場，可能造成生與死的區別，野牛兜蟲蝦蛄鴕鳥銀背大猩猩都是高手

programme.title: 金厲害潛水艇
programme.desc: 年輕天真的海豚金厲害帶領一艘裝滿魚兒和海水的另類潛水艇，打算前往他們夢寐以求,具有純淨水源的陸地拉斯維加斯，但這段奇葩的海陸大冒險沿途總是波折不斷，有時內憂有時外患,一點也不平靜

programme.title: 兔巴哥大工程小短片

programme.title: 恐龍邦尼的世界

programme.title: 兔巴哥大工程

programme.title: 超級蝙蝠車第1季

programme.title: 湯姆貓與傑利鼠

programme.title: 豆豆先生
programme.desc: 豆豆先生帶著相機想要捕捉大自然的美態，可是反被大自然捕捉的他感到非常糗也非常生氣!原來是受到野生動物紀錄片的啟發，豆豆先生拿起他塵封已久的老相機出發到郊外想要捕捉完美的野生動物照片,不過瞎忙了兩天卻一點收獲也沒有,最後還發現自己竟然才是被捕捉的對象！

programme.title: 少年悍將 Go
programme.desc: 少年悍將！GO是2013年卡通頻道和華納製作的卡通電視節目也是DC系列少年悍將漫畫的改編卡通，跟前作不同點在於，本作畫法以萌系畫風呈現，更大的特點是它著重在喜劇效果上，沒有前作的黑暗嚴肅氣氛，劇中多圍繞在少年悍將們的平時生活本做最大的看點是製作組將許多DC的人物做為背景角色呈現

programme.title: 怪盜喬克
programme.desc: 主人公的怪盜JOKER與助手小八一起，不僅要從警察妨礙中逃出生天，還要與怪盜斯佩德女怪盜鑽石女王鬥智鬥勇下，一次次將寶物成功盜走

programme.title: 超級小白:31
programme.desc: 野原小白，一隻看起來不能再平凡的小狗其實是隻超能狗平日就在維持和平的小白在帶上超能S章後就會自信爆棚他，只有一個目標，就是保護傳說中的Bobobobobone，聽說誰得到它就能統治世界

programme.title: 農場雞動隊
programme.desc: 最不像英雄的英雄小隊農場雞動隊 總是在動物們有危難時跳出來神救援小隊由四隻農場動物外加一顆蛋所組成，他們渴望藉由冒險救援跳脫平凡的農場生活，因此每天總是衝鋒陷陣到處幫忙！

programme.title: 難捕
programme.desc: 從實驗室裡逃脫的黏TT橙色生物！可是身為偽裝界變身達人的難捕就像他的名字一樣難捕! 哪有那麼簡單就被捉回去!看來這兩位瘋狂科學家的日子只會更加失控!更加混亂!

programme.title: 搖滾吧！寶貝
programme.desc: 一個超酷的寶寶樂團，即便受到討厭音樂的托兒所保母密切監督，這些音樂控寶貝們仍持續他們充滿歡樂與節奏的冒險， 快和娃娃飛仔 米呦卡羅斯與他們快抓狂的保母朵朵開一起隨著音樂大力搖擺！

programme.title: 愛煩多王子冒險中:10
programme.desc: 前往雄鷹之山的旅程中，愛煩多遇到了一隻變成人的詛咒牛蛙，而解開詛咒的唯一方式就是得到一個吻，不過呢，想到得到王子的親吻可不是一件容易的事

programme.title: 天兵公園-追憶錄影帶
programme.desc: 明明是簡單的工作卻引爆超現實又荒誕的災難! 反正只要有鳥哥和阿天在的地方，不管大事小事普通事都會變成令人難以置信的大混亂，當然也包括惹火老闆及同事給自己找麻煩

programme.title: 人皮獸-孤狼行動

programme.title: TRY科學:56
programme.desc: 你我的生活小問號，可能成就科學大發現所以號召全民try科學，活化每個人潛在的科學基因生雞蛋握掌心，為什麼連壯漢都捏不破？！一片口香糖，要怎麼打開沒拉環的易開罐？科學基因不限男女老幼貧富貴賤，科學現象不分校園街頭辦公室或客廳，Try科學想戳醒你不找答案不行的好奇心Try科學以放大生活中各種有趣現象為誘因，以主持人科學機智問答的闖關設計，透過科學MAN吸引眼球的科學實驗與找答案的邏輯推理讓科學接地氣，讓科學活用在生活裡

programme.desc: 懸崖上的生死對決，她將如何死裡逃生？！熱愛攀岩的凱莉，意外目睹閨蜜蘇菲慘遭四名男子殺害，為了躲避他們的追殺，她被迫在無人救援的深夜，徒手攀上陡峭的懸崖面對後有瘋狂歹徒緊追，前有絕命深淵的極限困局，凱莉必須在體力透支的邊緣與歹徒展開高空對決，試圖在恐懼中殺出一條生路！

programme.title: 絕命追殺令之就地正法
programme.desc: 火爆警探吉瑞德受命押解一名職業殺手，從芝加哥搭乘專機前往紐約受審，沒想到在飛行途中，有一名犯人掏出挾帶的手槍企圖射擊，不僅造成飛機失壓，乘客死傷慘重，犯人更趁亂逃逸無蹤吉瑞德不甘心犯人就此逃脫，於是展開天羅地網的追捕這時，年輕的FBI探員授命協助緝兇隨著詭譎多變的案情發展，吉瑞德赫然發現，這竟然與一場國際政府陰謀有關

programme.title: 空中救援
programme.desc: 高空危機，將仰賴他一人化解！美國聯邦空警比爾搭機前往倫敦，與同事傑克執行機上反恐危安任務起飛前，珍與人調換位子，坐到比爾旁靠窗的位子不久，比爾為解除搭機的恐懼，違反規定至廁所吸菸，就在這時，有人發簡訊給他，表示知道他是空警，也知道他違法吸菸，緊接著要求1.5億美金匯入帳戶，否則每20分鐘便會殺死一名乘客

programme.title: 史密斯先生
programme.desc: 沒有人知道他來自何方的神秘人物史密斯先生，某日在街頭吃紅蘿蔔等公車時，眼見一名大腹便便的孕婦遭人追殺，不忍婦人有難，他出手相救過程中，孕婦產下一子，隨後因傷重身亡史密斯臨危受命，當起英國超級奶爸，帶著男嬰亡命天涯為了解決男嬰的飲食問題，史密斯帶他求助在妓院討生活的關坦娜這時，追殺孕婦的這幫歹徒尾隨在後，究竟是什麼原因，讓這幫匪徒要置男嬰於死地？！

programme.title: 衝出封鎖線2

programme.title: 緊急動員

programme.title: 殺手47

programme.title: 一字千金:21
programme.desc: 字是一種文化的保存和演進，代表著人與人間的溝通及資訊的傳遞而繁體字是中華文化最燦爛的瑰寶之一！無論在字意的表達以及字形的美觀上都有著非常高的價值中文的美造字的藝術背後的含意，不是英文字母不是圓圈線條構成的文字所能比擬的為了提高當下電視節目的內容深度，為了關注青少年對國字知識與文化傳統的認知，為了重新燃起民眾對於國字的情感，同時也為青少年建造一個文化傳承的轉捩點，在益智遊戲競賽的架構下，一字千金期許能夠帶動正當社會風潮，重新將繁體國字發揚光大，再創中華文化新亮點

programme.desc: 該劇故事發生在名為音符國（Notevana）的奇幻世界，跟隨 4 歲小女孩芽芽與她的音樂夥伴們，在充滿旋律的森林中探索聲音動畫中的角色都與音樂元素息息相關透過無對白的呈現方式，劇集強調音樂是最純粹的溝通媒介，讓幼童在沒有語言說教的情況下，盡情發揮想像力並感受聲音的魅力

programme.title: 芽芽樂團:13
programme.desc: 該劇故事發生在名為音符國（Notevana）的奇幻世界，跟隨 4 歲小女孩芽芽與她的音樂夥伴們，在充滿旋律的森林中探索聲音動畫中的角色都與音樂元素息息相關透過無對白的呈現方式，劇集強調音樂是最純粹的溝通媒介，讓幼童在沒有語言說教的情況下，盡情發揮想像力並感受聲音的魅力

programme.title: 我們去公園玩:9
programme.desc: 會玩的人才知道，最有趣最不可思議的地方，就在你家附近的公園跟著在地的小朋友，一起去探索社區和公園吧，他們會帶我們走一條最好玩的路線，用不同以往的方式，啟動公園冒險吧！

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 第2季:7
programme.desc: 由雙胞胎醫生克里斯和山德帶小朋友了解身體的奧秘如何照顧自己的身體，並示範在家就可以做出的有趣實驗

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 第2季:8
programme.desc: 由雙胞胎醫生克里斯和山德帶小朋友了解身體的奧秘如何照顧自己的身體，並示範在家就可以做出的有趣實驗

programme.title: 一字千金:22
programme.desc: 字是一種文化的保存和演進，代表著人與人間的溝通及資訊的傳遞而繁體字是中華文化最燦爛的瑰寶之一！無論在字意的表達以及字形的美觀上都有著非常高的價值中文的美造字的藝術背後的含意，不是英文字母不是圓圈線條構成的文字所能比擬的為了提高當下電視節目的內容深度，為了關注青少年對國字知識與文化傳統的認知，為了重新燃起民眾對於國字的情感，同時也為青少年建造一個文化傳承的轉捩點，在益智遊戲競賽的架構下，一字千金期許能夠帶動正當社會風潮，重新將繁體國字發揚光大，再創中華文化新亮點

programme.title: 萬能的軟體動物
programme.desc: 強大的軟體動物常常出奇不意令人驚嘆！蛞蝓和蝸牛遠不是表面看起來那麼簡單的角色從烏賊墨魚到海蛞蝓，翻沙能手也好深海巨怪也罷，是素食者肉食者，還是解決難題的高手！軟體動物之間的關係錯綜複雜，地球上超過五分之一的動物都屬於軟體動物牠們的帝國繁盛已久，甚至連許多地形景觀，都是由牠們的遺骸堆積而成，萬能的軟體動物從巍峨山巔，到幽暗的深海熱液噴口，無處不在，牠們堪稱粘液界的終極倖存者，甚至能改善花園的生態健康

programme.title: 搖曳露營3
programme.desc: 第三季著重於獨旅與團體露營體驗於山梨靜岡等地展開富士山露營庭院露營賞櫻露營雨天露營穿梭吊橋之國體驗峭壁上的溫泉主角志摩凜騎著摩托車挑戰多座水壩與祕境吊橋，並在湖邊露營場與貓咪互動，享用熱騰騰的番茄義大利麵撫子則體驗單人小露營，品嚐水壩咖哩飯與生火腿奶油乳酪餅野外活動同好會的千明葵惠那前往山區露營，不僅傳承了領柴劈柴的社團傳統，葵更獲得了公路自行車女孩們最後圍繞著溫暖的篝火，品嚐蕎麥麵與墨西哥薄餅，笑談形狀像雞肉料理的富士雞五湖，期待更多露營時光

programme.title: 少年願望事務所
programme.desc: 每集會有一位許願者來到節目說出願望，透過主持人鄧惠文和黃豪平的穿針引線，以及大人和青少年組成的願望團，大家一起說個痛快聽得盡興！

programme.title: 鹹魚小隊
programme.desc: 俄烏戰爭的爆發，殘酷的說明國際情勢的瞬息萬變無論臺灣是否會遭遇戰爭，大朋友小朋友都應該學習防災知識與相關技能，以提升社會面對災難的韌性公視兒少科普實境節目－鹹魚小隊，由LIS情境科學教材的創辦人鹽八（嚴天浩），以及知名登山家義消山域搜救隊隊長三條魚（詹喬愉）主持兩人將以自身專業，以輕鬆有趣的風格，帶領青少年了解災難，進而勇於面對災難參與的青少年，將挑戰一系列製作單位以戰爭災難為藍圖設計的任務兩位主持人和專家，會透過科學實驗和救難演練，協助青少年習得挑戰任務所需要的知識與技能至於最後能否順利完成任務，就看青少年們的本事啦！

programme.title: 搖曳露營3

programme.desc: 沙富來羅嘉良父母早亡，貧困交加中把弟弟沙寶來馬國明帶大；為生存在馬來西亞當老千機緣巧合下，他盜用了卓祟禧私生子卓一鳴的身份，與視他為親弟弟的大哥卓一元呂良偉回到香港進入卓家，搖身一變成為豪門二少爺然而在他未冒認身分之前，曾邂逅卓家千金卓一心袁詠儀，並兩人互生情愫，這短暫的浪漫，讓卓一心痛苦不堪，即欲斬斷這假不倫戀卓家上下從未懷?沙富來身分，極力想補償這個受苦多年的兒子，讓沙富來得到他本來失落的家庭溫暖，也讓他享受著金錢和權力的巨大誘惑，漸漸陷入貪婪恐懼嫉妒的人性試煉...

programme.desc: 經營雪濃湯店的單親媽媽朴善子（金海淑 飾），含辛茹苦將三個女兒撫養長大大女兒姜美善（裕善 飾）是標準的職業婦女，在蠟燭兩頭燒的職場與家庭間疲於奔命，不僅要應付強勢挑剔的婆婆，還得將年幼的女兒託付給娘家媽媽照顧二女兒姜美莉（金素妍 飾）是擁有高學歷與高薪的大企業行銷部長，為了不讓母親操心，美莉拚命工作，但在遇上新進職員韓泰柱（洪宗玄 飾）後，不僅感情迎來轉變，隱藏在身世背後與親生母親的複雜糾葛也逐漸浮上檯面小女兒姜美慧（金荷景 飾）曾是拿過文學獎的天才小說家，如今卻陷入漫長的創作低潮，只能暫時在媽媽的湯店裡幫忙打雜，尋找人生的下一個方向母女間時而爭吵時而相依為命的深厚羈絆，最堅強的後盾，就是媽媽?

programme.title: 一秒拳王
programme.desc: 周天仁終日在酒吧渾噩，兒子對他毫不尊敬，?了躲避債主，天仁運用一秒預知超能力成功逃脫，意外被屢戰屢敗的拳擊教練阿信發現，拉攏他合作挑戰秒殺拳王Joe，堂妹小瑤多番阻撓也無補於事一秒雖然很短，卻能創出宇宙；從未認真看待自己的天仁，決定藉此難得機會，運用這個超能力，在擂臺上尋回失落已久的人生初衷，?了自己，?了兒子，好好活一次！其實輸怎會一世，贏又真的只在一秒？

programme.title: 宮
programme.desc: 現代女子兼古董店的繼承人洛晴川，在訂婚儀式上為了追一幅被風吹走的清裝美人圖而跑至一處神秘樹林中美人圖到手的一剎那卻腳下一空，跌入時空隧道並穿越到清朝康熙四十七年（即1708年），偶遇身在高位卻每日戰戰兢兢怕從高位上跌下來的太子胤礽，玩世不恭愛闖禍的八阿哥胤?，還有喜怒無常不相信任何人的四阿哥胤禛

programme.title: 反貪風暴之加密危機
programme.desc: 廉政公署調查主任駱一峰成立特別小組，利用加密貨幣案調查銀行高層的貪污事件，駱一峰找到程式設計師徐心協助，進入平台的後台搜證，調查中突然出現惡徒高調綁架銀行主席宋子文，並將影片發上網路，更要求以超高額的加密貨幣支付贖金，不然便會傷害人質，引發全城恐慌，廉政公署誓要全力緝兇

programme.title: 劌心劍
programme.desc: 洪武年間（即西元1368-1398年），錦衣衛丁武和蔣瑍奉旨查探一起重大貪腐案丁武和蔣瑍是錦衣衛內一對親如兄弟的小旗官，一個家有懷孕的老婆，苦於生計；一個愛上了青樓女子，需錢贖身兩人拼盡全力破案，為了愛人為了兄弟為了幸福，誓要建立大功改善現狀但兄弟二人屢屢受挫，線索接連中斷幕後黑手似乎早有準備，錦衣衛內藏有眼線眼看立功無望，急於救愛人的蔣瑍決定以身犯險，丁武逐漸與兄弟反目

programme.title: 我的麻吉4個鬼
programme.desc: 地獄倒楣男阿緯舉目無親無依無靠，老闆跑路工作也丟了，萬念俱灰下只想結束自己倒楣的人生，沒想到不僅死不成還被4個冤鬼纏身，衰上加衰！經過發發大師降落指點，只要完成4鬼遺願就可以送他們安心上路，於是阿緯只好心不甘情不願開始一段幫鬼圓夢的超級任務 過程中和救護員筱茵越走越近，阿緯的命運被這群鬼帶到一條全新的岔路

programme.title: 嚦咕嚦咕新年財
programme.desc: 德華（劉德華飾）天生喜愛打牌，以打牌維生，牌技和牌品俱佳，足跡踏遍各大小屋?，人稱麻將大俠詠琪（梁詠琪飾）是德華的舊女友，因牌品差遭德華狠撇，卻對德華戀戀不捨，常以不同的身份和形象出現糾纏著德華，令德華不勝其煩 另一方面，德華多年前因打麻將以致債台高築連累家庭，弟弟天樂（古天樂飾）因此仇視德華而且極度憎恨麻將，自此與母親（黃文慧飾）相依為命而且兄弟老死不相往來天樂憑一己實力圖強讀書希望為母親帶來安穩生活，可惜在經濟不景氣下失業且變成負資產，母親更患上了阿茲海默症，德華以打麻將替母醫病之餘，決重新擔起這頭家 一回，天樂被青雲（劉青雲飾）一伙人詐騙輸光，德華為弟弟出頭找青雲出氣，後來青雲牌技不如德華大敗，青雲欲拜德華為師但被拒時詠琪隆胸後又再出現找德華，但再次被拒愛，悲憤之下詛咒德華一世摸爛牌另一方面，青雲卻看中詠琪，對詠琪展開追求，詠琪為刺激德華而

programme.title: 大囍臨門

programme.title: 道士下山

programme.title: 人在囧途

programme.title: 紙人回魂

programme.title: 長歌行:17

programme.title: 小孩不笨2

programme.title: 成功補習班

programme.title: 笑傲江湖II東方不敗

programme.title: 師兄撞鬼

programme.title: 另一種注目
programme.desc: 另一種注目是一個具文化精神的紀實節目，從各種人物故事切入，以嶄新的視野與獨特的觀點，探索台灣社會文化的現象與脈絡，為這個時代留下紀錄

programme.title: 風味轉身
programme.desc: 有故事的台灣物產有故事的台灣農漁人，以及熱愛土地的知名料理人，共同挑戰一場風味轉身的旅程節目走訪台灣山林與海洋，從產地到餐桌，帶領觀眾探索台灣物產的前世今生，深入農漁現場，貼近生產者的日常與堅持，聆聽土地孕育出的動人故事每一集將同時邀請知名主廚以獨特的料理視角重新詮釋在地食材，將產地面臨的挑戰化為創新的風味，讓每一道料理不只是美味，更承載土地人情與永續的價值，完成一場從產地到餐桌的精彩風味轉身

programme.title: 精武門
programme.desc: 1911年辛亥革命終推翻滿清帝制，建立民國然而成功衹是短暫，幾年間風雲激盪中國再次陷入軍閥割據，南北分裂，自己人關門打自己人之局面風乘火勢，外國列強趁機爭佔地盤，設立租界，坐地分肥，更恥笑國人為東亞病夫當時之武術界仍不知為恥，各門各派，同床異夢，各自為政，衹顧爭領風騷，猶如一盤散沙

programme.title: 機場特警:11
programme.desc: 香港警務處機場特警組（ASU）是一支準軍事化特種警察部隊，責任是維持機場警區的公共及航空安全反恐要員保護及災難支援等等故事由一宗機場劫案引發，一名疑犯逃走引發一宗嚴重交通意外，休班警員張景山（張振朗飾）章振赫（黃子恆飾）及辛凱晴（蔡思貝飾）剛好來到機場，參與現場救人及捉拿疑犯的行動

programme.title: 舞動全城:15
programme.desc: 醉心舞蹈的李心盈廖碧兒一心投考香港舞蹈團，卻在考試前在超市遇上哥哥李力強黎耀祥和同事程嘉俊馬浚偉，盈不慎被俊的手推車絆倒，令盈在選拔試中失準，錯失機會

programme.title: 翻生武林:18
programme.desc: 朝廷打壓武林，五大派被收編英雄名冊，交由東廠提督仇不群管治，江湖名存實亡，英雄不再！玉雲龍跟姐姐嬌鳳經營平安客棧，一直遠離武林中事但雲龍為奪舊愛艾冰冰芳心，決意逐鹿新晉英雄大賽，卻因揭發東廠黑幕被押入大牢嬌鳳為救雲龍，訛稱平安客棧暗藏異寶，招致各路隱世英雄齊集仇在心奉義父不群之命親近雲龍探查寶物，與雲龍漸生情愫，二人更無意中救出被困多年的武林盟主任我飛！沉睡多時的武林，可會因此翻生？

programme.title: 法證先鋒4:5
programme.desc: 香港法證部高級化驗師高安法醫科高級醫生聞家希西九龍重案組高級督察郭輝煌，這滅罪鐵三角帶領著精英團隊，用專業的法證科學，揭示驚人的預謀策劃；用精密的法醫知識，破解隱蔽的人體密碼；用嚴謹的執法精神，披露震撼的罪惡真相！熱血記者徐意，童年憾事竟與高安緊扣牽連；法證專才水慧明，遭至愛背叛頓成殺人疑兇

programme.title: 機場特警:11
programme.desc: 香港警務處機場特警組（ASU）是一支準軍事化特種警察部隊，責任是維持機場警區的公共及航空安全反恐要員保護及災難支援等等故事由一宗機場劫案引發，一名疑犯逃走引發一宗嚴重交通意外，休班警員張景山（張振朗飾）章振赫（黃子恆飾）及辛凱晴（蔡思貝飾）剛好來到機場，參與現場救人及捉拿疑犯的行動

programme.title: 天天天晴:37
programme.desc: 龍福是本地名門石敢當集團旗下的珠寶店，在老闆娘明心安領導下，經歷九七回歸亞洲金融風暴沙士和金融海嘯等大大小小風波，由瀕臨結業至成為數一數二的珠寶店品牌精明的心深受店內員工及同行敬重，令人艷羨雖然風光背後事業和家庭各有隱憂，但樂觀的她積極面對，充滿正能量

programme.title: 法網狙擊:4
programme.desc: 律師甘祖贊（謝天華飾）與刑事檢控官況天藍（楊怡飾）本是同居情侶，但一次求婚不遂令兩人分手收場，不過命運弄人，祖贊剛轉職成為刑事檢控官，再度與天藍共處，但二人辦案手法截然不同，加上新秘書祝雙悅（王君馨飾）的介入，令惡劣的關係到了無可挽救的地步，但祖贊為拒婚一事一直耿耿於懷，孰知天藍真的另有隱情

programme.title: 好日子:10
programme.desc: 湯家村村委會主任湯志成的兒子從美國歸來，帶回土地使用的新理念湯家村的經濟想要更上一層樓，需與鄰村經濟基礎較差有不少閒置土地的于家堡村合作，雙方均會受益比鄰的于家堡村土地產值低並有不少閒置土地于家堡村主任於長福因擔心合作過程中失去自己主任的權利，抵制優厚條件和高利潤分成合作

programme.desc: 律師甘祖贊（謝天華飾）與刑事檢控官況天藍（楊怡飾）本是同居情侶，但一次求婚不遂令兩人分手收場，不過命運弄人，祖贊剛轉職成為刑事檢控官，再度與天藍共處，但二人辦案手法截然不同，加上新秘書祝雙悅（王君馨飾）的介入，令惡劣的關係到了無可挽救的地步，但祖贊為拒婚一事一直耿耿於懷，孰知天藍真的另有隱情

programme.title: 翻生武林:18
programme.desc: 朝廷打壓武林，五大派被收編英雄名冊，交由東廠提督仇不群管治，江湖名存實亡，英雄不再！玉雲龍跟姐姐嬌鳳經營平安客棧，一直遠離武林中事但雲龍為奪舊愛艾冰冰芳心，決意逐鹿新晉英雄大賽，卻因揭發東廠黑幕被押入大牢嬌鳳為救雲龍，訛稱平安客棧暗藏異寶，招致各路隱世英雄齊集仇在心奉義父不群之命親近雲龍探查寶物，與雲龍漸生情愫，二人更無意中救出被困多年的武林盟主任我飛！沉睡多時的武林，可會因此翻生？

programme.title: 法證先鋒4:5
programme.desc: 香港法證部高級化驗師高安法醫科高級醫生聞家希西九龍重案組高級督察郭輝煌，這滅罪鐵三角帶領著精英團隊，用專業的法證科學，揭示驚人的預謀策劃；用精密的法醫知識，破解隱蔽的人體密碼；用嚴謹的執法精神，披露震撼的罪惡真相！熱血記者徐意，童年憾事竟與高安緊扣牽連；法證專才水慧明，遭至愛背叛頓成殺人疑兇

programme.title: 真情:6
programme.desc: 李標炳（劉丹 飾）和妻子梁潤善（李司棋 飾）結婚多年，靠著經營燒臘店為生，儘管生活不易，但兩人彼此珍惜，為家庭付出，內心充實著幸福和滿足然而，他們的親情觀和家庭觀全並沒有遺傳給下一代，家中的四個兒女需要依靠他們自己的力量走完人生路...

programme.title: 天天天晴:39

programme.desc: 藥物研發員傅雲深與外科醫生朱舊在欠發達地區進行人道醫療救援，兩人從誤解到經歷生死後的兩心相許，還來不及坦誠心意，一場事故讓傅雲深陷入人生低谷，他斬斷與朱舊的聯繫一年後，朱舊以家庭醫生的身份與傅雲深重逢，面對他的百般刁難，朱舊用堅韌樂觀的心態與不離不棄的愛慢慢治癒雲深，陪他走出黑暗深淵

programme.title: The Wandering Swordsman
programme.desc: The wandering swordsman Yu Hsieh Erh has formidable sword skills and helps the poor by robbing from thieves and distributing the wealth. He meets a group of bandits who are planning to rob a convoy escorting some valuables and is tricked into participating in the robbery. Yu soon realizes his folly and returns to take revenge on the bandits.

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parents consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her...

programme.title: Dream of the Red Chamber1977
programme.desc: Adapted from the great Chinese classic novel of the same name, the son of renowned Jia family, Bao Yu, is deeply in love with his cousin, Dai Yu. However, his mother disapproves of their relationship and plots to arrange Bao Yu to marry another rich girl, resulting in a tragic ending for the perfect couple.

programme.title: Angel with the Iron Fists
programme.desc: Lo Wei directs and stars as the chief detective in this gripping thriller playing alongside Lily Ho, who excels in the role of an undercover avenger that can fight as well as she flirts! Caught between the crime bosses known as Baldhead and Black Widow, she only has four choices: punch, kick, shoot or bombard with explosives!

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer 1M for her baby...

programme.title: The Savage Five
programme.desc: A group of bandits flees with a stolen safe to a village where they oppress the villagers and force the blacksmith Wei to unlock the safe. Wei refuses and flees to report to officials, while heroes of the town emerge to fight the bandits.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxus enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the Deer Sword. Lians wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiaos home and he treats her poisonous wound. This leads Lian to suspect his wifes faithfulness and results in several blood-splattering duels with Xiao.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy familys daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his familys background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiancee, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: The heroine Yu Fei Xia is accused of stealing the book of martial arts secrets. To prove her innocence, she disguises herself as a man and finds her way into the Shaolin Temple to find out the truth...

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain mens life essence. With a Taoists help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: Accepted to the Golden Sword School after his father sacrificed his life to save his master, Fang Kang is resented by his fellow pupils and decides to leave. His masters daughter challenges him to a fight and cuts off his arm. Fang masters the art of sword fighting with one arm and finds himself returning to the School to save his master again.

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriends baby...

programme.title: The Treasure Hunters
programme.desc: An elite fortune hunter and a reckless young heir team up to search for a legendary pirate treasure. Their quest leads them to a remote monastery, where they must outwit a formidable Shaolin monk. However, when ruthless bandits close in, the unlikely allies must put aside their differences and fight side by side to survive.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular Venom Lo Meng.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as City Lights, is the directorwriters warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who

programme.title: The Twin Swords
programme.desc: Gui Wu and his wife Gan Lian Zhu are the famous Twin Swords in the martial arts world. One day, they stumble upon a kidnapping plot at the Red Lotus Temple and Lian Zhu is held captive. Wu successfully escapes to find the Gan family for help, not knowing that he is sending them into an ambush by the kidnappers. Can he finally save Lian Zhu?

programme.title: A Deadly Secret
programme.desc: A corrupt magistrate, obsessed with finding a hidden treasure, jails and tortures his daughters lover and buries his daughter alive! Ironically, it is in her coffin that the secret to the hidden treasure is found, setting off a frenzy of destruction.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: Perils Of The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Chu Liuxiang and the Eighth Prince stage a fake assassination attempt, allowing Chu to infiltrate Ghostly Manor as an undercover agent and eradicate this den of evil. The manor harbours notorious martial arts criminals and is rumoured to be haunted. Soon, during his investigation, Chu becomes entangled in a series of mysterious and eerie events.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Ambitious Kung Fu Girl
programme.desc: Si Si, a spoiled and naive rich girl with only basic kung fu training, becomes enchanted by the legends of the fearless hero Qin Ge. Determined to escape her fathers arranged marriage, she disguises herself as a man and sets out to find him, hoping to challenge Qin Ge-only to be drawn into a deadly plot within the criminal underworld.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders, it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: One-armed Swordsman Fang Kang wants to lead a quiet life with his wife, but when she is abducted by the Eight Demon Swordsmen clan, he is forced to take them on in order to save her.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Yi Yi Xiang Bei Feng
programme.desc: CCTV brings you broadcasts of finely-produced artistic dramas that closely follow the pulse of the times.

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Openthe Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her fathers debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her fathers wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from The Sutra of 42 Chapters.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Mans matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yis husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the Happy Spinsters Club set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: The legendary swordsman Li, entrusts the Green Destiny sword to a noble house for safekeeping. It is swiftly stolen by Yu, a young aristocrat of immense martial skills trained by an unscrupulous outlaw master. Recognising her talent, Li tries to guide her towards righteousness but ultimately leads them both to a tragic fate.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tams life. Mas fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: The Myth
programme.desc: Guided by mysterious dreams, archaeologist Jack discovers he was General Meng Yi in a past life and shared a tragic love with Princess Ok-Soo that spanned a thousand years. When they reunite in Emperor Qins celestial palace, a ruthless tycoon seeks the secret of immortality. Reclaiming his past strength, Jack faces a final battle of destiny.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the schools stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has posttraumatic stress disorder after his wifes death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firms VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Hong Kong detective Eddie dies while rescuing a mystical child during an international search for a human trafficking syndicate. Revived by the sacred Medallion, he gains extraordinary healing powers. However, when his ruthless nemesis also seizes its power, Eddie must storm a sinister castle and fight in a brutal battle for survival.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggars gang when he saves the gangs elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yues house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror her father is peeping at night and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian and seek evidence against his gang. After their release, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, as Shan cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its Cop Shop Babes as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Lets Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macaus Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the citys casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A reactivated backup Chinese agent, posing as a butcher, is unexpectedly assigned to recover a stolen dinosaur skull. Sent to Hong Kong, he is aided by a female agent who is secretly working for the villains. Together, they navigate betrayals and confront the mastermind, ultimately recovering the national treasure and exposing the conspiracy.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia And The Babies

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivias Pirate Treasure

programme.desc: O記幹探許浚森陳展鵬飾沈韋力黃智賢飾奉命調查跨國罪案期間，得悉殺虎案幕後黑手魏子樂張頴康飾落網前，曾將神秘訊息發送至暗網，並匯出巨額加密貨幣不久有神秘人策動恐襲，浚森與韋力縱於天才教授唐冠峰方力申飾協助下破案，卻驚覺子樂背後藏着更大陰謀！他們要竭力阻止子樂的同時，也遇到龍頭棍風暴空屋藏白骨重犯越獄等奇案，能否一一掃除險阻？工作上面對的危機升級，感情亦遇挑戰，浚森望跟前女友馬穎思林夏薇飾復合，但困難重重令二人關係出現變數.

programme.title: 赤沙印記 四葉草.2 Sunshine Heartbeat
programme.desc: 沙灘上，少年十五二十時；他們拋汗， 他們隨入情網葉菁楊婉儀葉蕙李思欣及葉茵陳自琦三姊妹小時侯 碰到一個古上賊女郎部容衢兒，女郎預言大家姐將在十八歲那年，遇見身上有四葉草胎記的真命天子轉眼間三姊妹已長大，現在是清嵐國際學校的中六生清嵐沙灘排球隊的隊長干逸臣司徒瑞祈外表俊朗性格活潑，是校內的風頭人物，很多女同學也為了他而加入沙灘排球隊，猶如行星屋繞太陽一般一日，三姊妹分別在不同的角度看見臣身上有一個近似四葉草形狀的胎記，跟小時侯聽到的預言吻合，但菁為人優柔寡斷沒有主見，菁與茵因因此拋身而出，為製造機會給姐姐而不斷奔走不久，三姊妹亦加入了沙灘排球隊她們覺得的是，她們竟又在校內的壘學士方上發現四葉草胎記！三姊妹頓感迷悶，不知道吉卜賽女郎所言的真命天子究竟是誰.

programme.title: 食為奴 Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: 高天寶王祖藍自小吃盡珍饈百味，各種美食經他一嚐便知龍與鳳，但遭逢家道中落被迫與家僕李衛胡諾言流落街頭，以賣飽糊口，因美食令他結識了賣藝女子紀慕雪萬綺雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女廚神米小魚何雁詩等人，更因緣際會遇上微服出遊的四皇子胤禛黃智賢，二人氣味相投，被引進到宮內的御膳房當御廚，天寶遇上宿敵蔡鶴亭林盛斌，掀起連場龍爭虎鬥；但天寶萬料不到自己竟捲入由八皇子胤禩張繼聰策動的奪嫡之爭中，在劣勢下天寶成了胤禛的福將，連番替他反敗為勝，但一段意外的婚約卻令天寶由一人之下頓貶為喪家狗.

programme.title: 愛情食物鏈 Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: 從事食品供應的魯佳芳阮小儀樣子平凡，身材矮小，年過三十仍欠缺戀愛經驗，因一次苦瓜事件，幫助餐飲業才俊劉柏業陳智燊渡過難關，令這位高富帥欣賞到佳芳的內在美，並與她漸生情愫，佳芳的鄰居兼好友高貴芬高海寧對此無法釋懷，賣魚出身的貴芬樣貌身材皆屬女神級數，千方百計也未能令柏業過電，卻召來台灣擔仔麵繼承者洪鱻金剛的青睞，洪鱻為親近貴芬不惜自貶身價與佳芳她們同住劏房，貴芬得不到柏業唯有轉戰二叔劉利高鄭子誠，但後來柏業承受不了外界對女友佳芳的負評，二人關係亮起紅燈；當愛情再不是飲水飽，美醜優劣再無標準，男女同時成了獵人與獵物，血肉橫飛的戀愛激戰即將一發不可收拾.

programme.title: 逆天奇案2 Sinister Beings 2
programme.desc: O記幹探許浚森陳展鵬飾沈韋力黃智賢飾奉命調查跨國罪案期間，得悉殺虎案幕後黑手魏子樂張頴康飾落網前，曾將神秘訊息發送至暗網，並匯出巨額加密貨幣不久有神秘人策動恐襲，浚森與韋力縱於天才教授唐冠峰方力申飾協助下破案，卻驚覺子樂背後藏着更大陰謀！他們要竭力阻止子樂的同時，也遇到龍頭棍風暴空屋藏白骨重犯越獄等奇案，能否一一掃除險阻？工作上面對的危機升級，感情亦遇挑戰，浚森望跟前女友馬穎思林夏薇飾復合，但困難重重令二人關係出現變數.

programme.title: 大醬園 Dripping Sauce, The
programme.desc: 萬冠園是佛山醬油業百年老字號，大當家萬啟山吳岱融飾與夫人席德容龔慈恩飾堅持傳男不傳女，傳內不傳外的宗旨，可是一宗毒醬油事故，使他不得不答應讓夏小滿朱晨麗飾及葉細么龔嘉欣飾兩女子加入，與其子萬卓楓何廣沛飾成為同期學徒三人與醬園小師傅華歌吳業坤飾建立了複雜的四角關係，又間接揭發了萬家多個秘密，加上卓楓突然被擄走，人心惶惶醬園內，啟山幾個弟弟啟石鄭子誠飾啟川陳嘉輝飾及啟江徐榮飾醞釀分家，醬園外，專員高兆榮袁文傑飾也密謀奪取醬園財產，萬冠園百年基業隨時毀於一旦！.

programme.title: 食為奴 Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: 高天寶王祖藍自小吃盡珍饈百味，各種美食經他一嚐便知龍與鳳，但遭逢家道中落被迫與家僕李衛胡諾言流落街頭，以賣飽糊口，因美食令他結識了賣藝女子紀慕雪萬綺雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女廚神米小魚何雁詩等人，更因緣際會遇上微服出遊的四皇子胤禛黃智賢，二人氣味相投，被引進到宮內的御膳房當御廚，天寶遇上宿敵蔡鶴亭林盛斌，掀起連場龍爭虎鬥；但天寶萬料不到自己竟捲入由八皇子胤禩張繼聰策動的奪嫡之爭中，在劣勢下天寶成了胤禛的福將，連番替他反敗為勝，但一段意外的婚約卻令天寶由一人之下頓貶為喪家狗.

programme.desc: 從事食品供應的魯佳芳阮小儀樣子平凡，身材矮小，年過三十仍欠缺戀愛經驗，因一次苦瓜事件，幫助餐飲業才俊劉柏業陳智燊渡過難關，令這位高富帥欣賞到佳芳的內在美，並與她漸生情愫，佳芳的鄰居兼好友高貴芬高海寧對此無法釋懷，賣魚出身的貴芬樣貌身材皆屬女神級數，千方百計也未能令柏業過電，卻召來台灣擔仔麵繼承者洪鱻金剛的青睞，洪鱻為親近貴芬不惜自貶身價與佳芳她們同住劏房，貴芬得不到柏業唯有轉戰二叔劉利高鄭子誠，但後來柏業承受不了外界對女友佳芳的負評，二人關係亮起紅燈；當愛情再不是飲水飽，美醜優劣再無標準，男女同時成了獵人與獵物，血肉橫飛的戀愛激戰即將一發不可收拾.

programme.title: 逆天奇案2 Sinister Beings 2
programme.desc: O記幹探許浚森陳展鵬飾沈韋力黃智賢飾奉命調查跨國罪案期間，得悉殺虎案幕後黑手魏子樂張頴康飾落網前，曾將神秘訊息發送至暗網，並匯出巨額加密貨幣不久有神秘人策動恐襲，浚森與韋力縱於天才教授唐冠峰方力申飾協助下破案，卻驚覺子樂背後藏着更大陰謀！他們要竭力阻止子樂的同時，也遇到龍頭棍風暴空屋藏白骨重犯越獄等奇案，能否一一掃除險阻？工作上面對的危機升級，感情亦遇挑戰，浚森望跟前女友馬穎思林夏薇飾復合，但困難重重令二人關係出現變數.

programme.title: 大醬園 Dripping Sauce, The
programme.desc: 萬冠園是佛山醬油業百年老字號，大當家萬啟山吳岱融飾與夫人席德容龔慈恩飾堅持傳男不傳女，傳內不傳外的宗旨，可是一宗毒醬油事故，使他不得不答應讓夏小滿朱晨麗飾及葉細么龔嘉欣飾兩女子加入，與其子萬卓楓何廣沛飾成為同期學徒三人與醬園小師傅華歌吳業坤飾建立了複雜的四角關係，又間接揭發了萬家多個秘密，加上卓楓突然被擄走，人心惶惶醬園內，啟山幾個弟弟啟石鄭子誠飾啟川陳嘉輝飾及啟江徐榮飾醞釀分家，醬園外，專員高兆榮袁文傑飾也密謀奪取醬園財產，萬冠園百年基業隨時毀於一旦！.

programme.title: 大醬園 Dripping Sauce, The
programme.desc: 萬冠園是佛山醬油業百年老字號，大當家萬啟山吳岱融飾與夫人席德容龔慈恩飾堅持傳男不傳女，傳內不傳外的宗旨，可是一宗毒醬油事故，使他不得不答應讓夏小滿朱晨麗飾及葉細么龔嘉欣飾兩女子加入，與其子萬卓楓何廣沛飾成為同期學徒三人與醬園小師傅華歌吳業坤飾建立了複雜的四角關係，又間接揭發了萬家多個秘密，加上卓楓突然被擄走，人心惶惶醬園內，啟山幾個弟弟啟石鄭子誠飾啟川陳嘉輝飾及啟江徐榮飾醞釀分家，醬園外，專員高兆榮袁文傑飾也密謀奪取醬園財產，萬冠園百年基業隨時毀於一旦！.

programme.title: 巨輪 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 喬天生（陳展鵬飾）和羅威信（蕭正楠飾）是同母異父的親兄弟，因為命運令他們不單分開在香港和澳門兩地，更令他們嘗盡劇變歷史中的兩極衝突 母親周玉梅（李司棋飾）帶著小兒子威信在澳門當黑市居民，威信憑著努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮飾）與龍飛（阮兆祥飾）的相助，歷盡艱辛，克服挑戰，最終踏上成功之路獨自在港自食其力的天生卻改走捷徑，聯結黑道古惑仔姜勇（張繼聰飾），與富家女發生關係，令女友卓靜（鍾嘉欣飾）傷心欲絕，最終落得人財兩空 本是唇齒相依的手足情，經歷時代巨輪的洗禮，前境變幻莫測，二人愈走愈遠，但一個信念深植在他們相連的血脈裡，縱然考驗再苦再難，終在一條又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 陪著你走 Every Step You Take
programme.desc: 雜誌攝影師宋天從胡杏兒因一場意外，失去了雙親也失去了光明，天性愛美和煲電視劇的天從卻未有自暴自棄，男朋友杜正恆張穎康和導盲犬的陪伴令她漸漸重拾自信，她的座右銘更是一句廣告標題愛是無所不能，成為她從傷痛中走出來的力量，誰料這個廣告的創作人甘言重陳豪如今就住在她的隔鄰因沉溺工作令言重失去所有朋友和同事，連徒弟阮婉姚子羚也決定辭職，言重有點迷失，決定放一個悠長假期，重回舊居生活，尋回昔日好朋友余加勁麥長青重回舊地，不單令言重重新出發，更讓他重新認識自己，男友移情別戀令天從再度陷入低潮，幸有言重在旁成為守護天使，二人風馬牛不相及的性格竟擦出了愛火花，以為看見的卻發現盲點，本是瞎眼的卻得見光明.

programme.title: 使徒行者3 Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: 薛家強林峯飾完成三年臥底任務後，回港開設沐足店，繼續收集情報刑事情報科總督察章紀孜黃智雯飾懷疑卓凱苗僑偉飾出獄後投入黑道，對他進行全面監視家強與卓凱捲入器官販賣案，聯同女臥底竇亞希蔡思貝飾及保安局調查官韋作榮馬國明飾，合力搗破涉案集團保安局及後新設安全情報機構，並邀得徐天堂袁偉豪飾加入，接管刑事情報科的工作覃歡喜許紹雄飾逃過一死後，暗中調查某社團的秘密神秘社團原來由長興已故龍頭魏德信的弟弟魏德禮創立，他還設下佈局，對家強卓凱等展開報復.

programme.title: 刀下留人 Executioner, The
programme.desc: 殺人無數的劊子手葉常綠黃德斌為保護恩公的媳婦阮素心姚子羚順利產子，將素心安頓在京城享負盛名的穩婆花蕊紅邵美琪家中，因而遇上離奇命案，常綠竟以其鬼頭刀救活了一條小生命，誰料這名來歷不明的男嬰令常綠和蕊紅無故捲入朝廷的政治漩渦，一冷一熱的配搭化解了一次又一次的危機，兩人在患難中漸生情愫；另邊廂，一對同在妓院長大的小情侶赤知秋楊明和祝小滿龔嘉欣來到蕊紅家，苦苦哀求常綠收知秋為劊子手的學徒，知秋其心不正，只想藉此逃脫受刑，常綠遲疑不決，一名神秘的彩戲師司馬丑陳山聰出現，令各人關係陷入錯綜複雜，男嬰身分之謎更因而被逐步揭開，但同時敲起了死神的喪鐘.

programme.title: 兄弟 Fist Fight
programme.desc: 來自英國的保鏢主管夏天行楊明，到港後奉命保護網絡教主張非凡王浩信，順道尋覓身世線索非凡行事張狂，還藉舉辦拳賽掩護竊密黑客赴港，期間屢遇險境麻煩，幸得天行一一化解事件引來火爆刑警何鐵男伍允龍關注，決心全力追查原來鐵男曾因一時衝動犯下不可告人的過失，性格亦漸走偏鋒拳賽同時激發三人的好戰天性，他們又逐漸發現彼此擁有相同的感應能力，藉以互助互救而三人背後的隱密連繫，更牽涉逾二十年前的金融風暴之戰.

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Syarfan merupkan pengurus besar di sebuah syarikat automotif milik keluarganya. Akibat tergesa-gesa ingin menghadiri mesyuarat penting Syarfan tergelincir ketika melalui lantai yang basah. Accident itu telah menjadi satu titik pertemuan diantara Syarfan dan Antasya seorang gadis cantik yang bekerja sebagai seorang cleaner di syarikatnya.

programme.title: Dulang Boy
programme.desc: Dulang Boy mengisahkan tentang seorang budak lelaki berusia 10 tahun bernama Kerol Lazania KL yang teruja kerana dipilih menjadi dulang boy untuk majlis perkahwinan kakaknya, Ros. Tugasnya adalah membawa dulang berisi sepasang kasut yang dianggap sangat Istimewa. Namun, pada pagi majlis perkahwinan, KL dan sahabat baiknya Yoyo mencuri masa untuk bergambar dengan kasut tersebut. Malangnya, KL terpijak lumpur lalu mengotorkan kasut tersebut. Mereka cuba mencuci kasut itu, tetapi akhirnya kasut tersebut koyak pula. KL dan Yoyo kemudian berusaha sedaya upaya untuk membetulkan keadaan sebelum majlis bermula.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Aisyah merindui kampung halaman, dia bersendirian di dalam kondo. Iskandar langsung tidak menghiraukan Aisyah dan terus membiarkan Aisyah bergerak sendiri di dalam kondo. Perbezaan alatan yang canggih di kondo itu membuatkan Aisyah sering melakukan kesilapan dan membuatkan dia dimarahi oleh Iskandar. Aisyah membiarkan dirinya terus dimarahi, kepergian dan kepulangan Iskandar ke kondo itu tidak langsung membuatkan mereka berhubung. Namun, disebabkan Aisyah seorang gadis kampung yang cerdik dan rajin, dia tidak pernah berhenti menyediakan makanan untuk Iskandar, segala keperluan memasak di pesan oleh Aisyah kepada Haziq yang sering datang ke kondo untuk menghilangkan rasa sunyi Aisyah meskipun Iskandar turut berada di kondo mewah itu. Hidup Aisyah yang bagaikan seorang isteri di dalam sebuah sangkar mewah dilenyapkan rasa sakit itu dengan aktiviti yang disukainya iaitu memasak. Disebabkan hidangan makanan yang lazat dan cukup membuka selera itu membuatkan mata Iskandar dan Aisyah kerap kali bertentang. Sementara satu pertemuan sedang di atur oleh Tengku Maria untuk meneruskan hasratnya menyatukan Iskandar dan Tengku Waiduri.

programme.desc: Pada Disember 1993, sebuah blok kondominium mewah runtuh selepas hakisan tanah dari lereng bukit bersebelahan. Kira-kira 50 orang terkorban dan kejadian ini sehingga kini menjadi salah satu tragedi paling gelap dan menyedihkan dalam sejarah Malaysia. Dua puluh tahun kemudian, pada 2013, sekumpulan pembuat filem dokumentari menjelajah ke dua blok yang masih berdiri untuk menjalankan ekspedisi memburu hantu. Apa yang mereka temui tidak sesuai untuk mereka yang lemah semangat.

Tanpa disedarinya, pertemuannya dengan Jalal telah memerangkapnya dalam sebuah sindiket jenayah. Walaupun Haziq dijanjikan peluang untuk memperbaiki hidupnya, Amelia sentiasa mengawasi setiap pergerakannya dengan teliti. programme.desc: Datuk Shaari dan Shahira diselamatkan oleh seorang lelaki yang mendakwa bahawa dirinya Hang Tuah, seorang pahlawan Melayu di abad ke-15. Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

programme.title: Darah Satria
programme.desc: Berpangkat Leftenan Muda, Ariff terlibat dalam operasi memburu komunis di hutan. Mempunyai seorang isteri bernama Rafidah, namun terpaksa ditinggalkannya bersama ibu bapanya kerana sibuk menjalankan operasi. Dalam satu operasi menentang komunis, Ariff bersama anak buahnya melalui kesukaran yang menyebabkan Ariff mengalami kecederaan manakala salah seorang daripada mereka terkorban.

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.title: Pecah
programme.desc: Empat orang lelaki berjaya merompak sebuah bank tetapi malangnya salah seorang daripada mereka cedera dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital. Pada masa yang sama, seorang wanita yang menjaga orang tua di sebuah rumah orang tua, membawa salah seorang penghuninya ke hospital yang sama untuk mendapatkan rawatan. Apa yang berlaku kemudiannya ialah pembongkaran demi pembongkaran agenda tersembunyi, di samping penyiasatan daripada pihak polis pada masa yang sama.

programme.title: Anak Sarawak

Filem ini mengikuti usaha sukarelawan Bulan Sabit Merah Palestin yang cuba mengekalkan talian komunikasi dengannya sambil berusaha menghantar bantuan menyelamat. Sebuah kisah menyentuh hati tentang kemanusiaan, konflik dan harapan di tengah tragedi perang.

programme.title: Diari Abah

Anak-anaknya menganggap kematian ibu mereka, Khalijad berpunca daripada keputusan Rahmat berkahwin lain. Namun mereka semua tersedar apabila Ashikin telah menyerahkan sebuah diari kepada mereka bertiga setelah Rahmat meninggal dunia. Tercatat dalam diari itu bahawa segala duit yang dikirimkan setiap bulan digunakan abah mereka untuk mendirikan rumah anak yatim atas permintaan arwah ibu mereka dengan nama Rumah Anak Yatim Cik Khalijah.

Meanwhile, Hoi-yan shockingly finds out Kwan-ngais real character. Leung-sing faces the danger of exhausting his mystical power and becoming a rat as he helps Hoi-yan.

programme.title: Return of the Cuckoo
programme.desc: Twenty years previously, CHU SHA KIU SIT KA YIN, NANCY met an undergraduate from Hong Kong, CHUK CHIN FAI KWOK FUNG and they immediately fell in love with each other. However soon afterwards, FAI decided to further his study in the United States. KIU, though had just found herself pregnant, agreed reluctantly to let him go just for the sake of his future. Since then, KIU has lived with her own daughter, CHUK KWAN HO SHEH CHARMAINE and her adopted child, MAN CHOR CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN. Having been abandoned by her lover, CHORs mother flied into a fury of grief and gave CHOR, who was then an infant, a corrosive substance to drink. CHOR was fortunately rescued by KIU in time but his vocal cords had become paralysed because of the serious damage. CHOR regards HO as his sister and does not realise his extraordinary passion for her until SZETO LAI SHUN MA CHUN WAI, STEVEN appears. HO is an affectionate girl and is always full of tender solicitude towards all. She is thus torn by the confusing emotions of love for the three men around her, CHOR, SHUN and KAM SING TONG MICHAEL. CHORs voice begins to recover after the vocal operation conducted by a renowned surgeon. As he feels that he is unable to bring HO any physical well-being, he withdraws and has decided to leave for Hong Kong to look for his own mother. Meanwhile, by thinking of HOs future, KIU urges HO to depart from Macau and to live with FAI. Who will win HOs heart eventually? Will KIU be left alone by HO and CHOR?

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: Big Boys Club is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friendsBob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The Other Dimension segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new childrens program Hands Up encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot Sauce Family join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of childrens songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: Big City Shop introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: The Truth Within Whats On Today
programme.desc: Haunted by his girlfriends suspicious death in a car crash, young forensic examiner Qi Sizhe transfers to a major crimes unit to find the truth. Teaming up with detective Zhu Qingyue and officer Han Feng, he investigates a series of bizarre murders. Through forensic evidence, they discover that every crime connects to an illegal synthetic drug ring called Original Diamondthe masterminds behind his girlfriends death.

programme.title: Her Railway Trip
programme.desc: Japans railway world is incredibly diverse, stretching from winding valleys to coastal lines. Every train window is like a flowing landscape painting, captivating railway enthusiasts. In recent years, it has also attracted many women, giving rise to the unique nickname Tetsuko meaning railway girl. The program, led by up-and-coming actresses Ni Jiawen and He Yongshao, takes viewers on a journey through the charm of Japanese railway travel. It not only introduces the railways themselves but also explores the prefectures and cities traversed by the railways, showcasing the unique landscape created by the intertwining of railways and towns. Whether youre a railway enthusiast or a viewer who enjoys exploring new cultures, Tetsukos Lofty Mountain offers a romantic and surprising railway journey.

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors.

programme.title: I Go To Taiwan On Foot
programme.desc: The best way to understand the local customs and culture is through in-depth travel, exploring every corner of the city on foot, appreciating the scenery along the way, discovering the local life and culture, and embracing unexpected surprises and challenges. Shih Chao-ri and Tsai Ching-hsing were lured to Taiwan by a production team to film a reality show. Starting from Kaohsiung Airport, they conquered over 300 kilometers, traveling from Tainan to Taipei. Visiting eight cities in eight days, with only NT1,000 per day, the two racked their brains to solve problems like transportation and food, while also completing various assigned tasks, even exchanging labor for accommodation with limited resources, they had to use any means necessary to achieve their goals

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.

programme.title: Cause Of Death
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan Hera Chan has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum Willie Wai. And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han Alice Wong, RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sums approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun Mark Ma. The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yans buddy Sin Pui-ka Jinny Ng becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu Nicholas Yuen evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yans career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-kas death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased!

programme.desc: Stylish Man The Chef is co-hosted by the Golden Bell Awards winner Sam Tseng and Genie Chuo, together with professional chef, James. There are two main themes for the program, which are Big Stars Come to Cook and Five-Star Cooking Show. Stylish Man The Chef containing not only the bomb of laughter, but the audience can also gain practical cooking knowledge throughout the program.

programme.title: Battle Tour - EastvsWest

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Different in age, generation, and hosting style, these three hosts not only can sing, act, dance, and imitate, but are also skilled in cross-talk! With this unique combination, we hope to attract viewers of all ages and spark great entertainment.

programme.title: The Sound of Happiness
programme.desc: Wu is a senior police officer has always wanted a son to carry his family name and join the force. However, he and wife are bequeathed with four daughters! As a doting father, his chief objective is to help them find happiness in their marriages. In this charming drama, Wu his wife become their daughters greatest haven, through the ups and downs they face as married women.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan presents a series of tales and folktales in Taiwan that have been pass down from one generation to another generation.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: The Brotherhood Of Rebel
programme.desc: Chai, a triad member, helps his childhood friend Meow flee Hong Kong after discovering that Meow attempted to kill his triad boss. 17 years later, Chai becomes a key member of the triad. When he runs into Meow one day, he knows that his gang will kill Meow if they find him. Caught between triad and brotherhood, what will Chai choose?

programme.title: Midnight Fly
programme.desc: With her marriage in crisis, Michele takes off to Europe for a vacation and meets a Japanese woman named Miki. As they become friends and travel together, Michele discovers that Miki is her husbands mistress. When Miki goes missing in Morocco, Michele does everything she can to find her but ends up paying a heavy price

programme.title: Coffin Homes
programme.desc: Three bizarre tales intertwine in this horror satire set against the housing crisis of Hong Kong, where soaring property prices have driven dwellers to take every insane effort necessary to secure a cramped space, even if it means sharing the same roof with the dead!

programme.title: Guilt By Design
programme.desc: On the final day of a shocking murder trial in Hong Kong, a renowned hypnotherapist serving as a juror receives a video showing his daughter being kidnapped. The abductors demand that he hypnotize the jury to manipulate the final verdict. Torn between justice and family, he must decide how far he is willing to go to save her.

programme.title: YOLO
programme.desc: Feeling lost and aimless, Le Ying chooses to withdraw from society after a short working experience. After a series of unexpected events one day, she decides to embrace life anew. She sees a chance for a fresh start when she meets a boxing coach, yet the challenges ahead far exceed her expectations, marking a vibrant start to her journey.

programme.title: Echoes Of The Thunder
programme.desc: Two half-brothers, Nam and Fire, are top racing drivers. In a racing challenge with Japanese driver Kenji, Nam causes a young racing driver to be seriously injured and is depressed. Fire stands up for Nam and decides to compete with Kenji in an illegal street car race. Who will win the race? Can Nam finally bounce back?

programme.title: True Love For Once in My Life
programme.desc: Sabrinas deep love for Andrew is shattered after his affair destroys their marriage, leaving her heartbroken. Years later, when Andrew is diagnosed with cancer, Sabrina chooses to return and care for her former husband despite the pain of the past. As old emotions resurface, she still believes true love comes only once in a lifetime.

programme.title: Marriage With A Liar
programme.desc: Kiki and her boyfriend of seven years, Sean, are to be married in a week but both cheated on each other three days before the wedding. Faced with each of their perfect partners, Kiki and Sean ignore their responsibilities to each other and choose to go their separate ways

programme.title: Good Game
programme.desc: Several down-and-out individuals find a spark in esports. From a cybercaf to the competitive arena, they form team Happy Hour, battling rivals and lifes setbacks to reclaim a second chance.

programme.title: Invincible Swordsman
programme.desc: Longing to leave the martial world behind, Linghu Chong is drawn into a fierce conflict between rival factions. He falls for the enigmatic Dongfang Bubai, whose secret acts of kindness save him. But manipulated by Ren Wo Xing into believing she slaughtered his fellow disciples, Linghu Chong is driven into a tragic, life-or-death showdown.

programme.title: Break Up Club
programme.desc: Joe is a 20-something slacker who only takes one thing seriously: his on-and-off girlfriend Flora. After their latest breakup, Joe goes to an audition for a documentary by director Barbara Wong. Handed a camera, Joe records his discovery of a magical website that reunites him with Flora at the price of breaking up his best friend and his girlfriend. However, despite the efficiency of the website, Joes refusal to change his immature ways and Floras attraction to a talented graffiti artist threatens to break them up once more.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: Time Still Turns the Pages
programme.desc: High school teacher Cheng recalls his violent childhood memories when he finds an anonymous suicide note in the classroom. While he has to prevent the tragedy involving a suicidal student from happening, he also has to face a series of family problems with his wife wanting to divorce him and his fathers serious illness.

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Hong Kong detective Eddie dies while rescuing a mystical child during an international search for a human trafficking syndicate. Revived by the sacred Medallion, he gains extraordinary healing powers. However, when his ruthless nemesis also seizes its power, Eddie must storm a sinister castle and fight in a brutal battle for survival.

programme.title: July Rhapsody
programme.desc: A 40-year-old high school teacher is in midlife crisis. His marriage is on the rocks and he is involved in a taboo romance with a female student who has a crush on him. Meanwhile, his wife is off to care for her dying ex-lover who shares a complicated history with the couple...

programme.title: Mad Fate
programme.desc: A Master fortune teller predicts that Tung, a born psychopath, will be imprisoned for murder and tries to change his fate. A veteran detective believes Tung is a psychopathic serial killer after witnessing him kill a cat, and pursues him relentlessly. Can the Master change Tungs mad fate?

programme.title: I Want to be Rich
programme.desc: Young Wah rises from a poverty-stricken background, carrying the heavy burden of caring for his gambling-addicted parents and younger siblings. Against all odds, his resilience and determination to provide a better life for his family eventually lead him to achieve significant success in real estatea testament that perseverance pays off.

programme.title: Invincible Swordsman
programme.desc: Longing to leave the martial world behind, Linghu Chong is drawn into a fierce conflict between rival factions. He falls for the enigmatic Dongfang Bubai, whose secret acts of kindness save him. But manipulated by Ren Wo Xing into believing she slaughtered his fellow disciples, Linghu Chong is driven into a tragic, life-or-death showdown.

programme.title: Valley of the Shadow of Death
programme.desc: Years after his daughters brutal death, the perpetrator reappears in church seeking forgiveness. Confronted with grief that never healed, Pastor Leung is torn between faith and vengeance. As buried emotions resurface and truths unravel, he faces a profound moral reckoning, forcing him to choose between justice and forgiveness.

programme.title: Rob N Roll
programme.desc: A ruthless bandit, Tian, has plotted an intense and quick armed robbery. When he encounters Hui and Shui who also plan for a robbery, they decide to team up for the heist. However, their ad-hoc and dramatic robbery has started a war with the police hot on pursuit, putting their lives on the line!

programme.title: Fox Hunt
programme.desc: Adapted from true events, Fraudster Dai swindled countless victims across China before vanishing without a trace. Seven years later, he resurfaces in Paris. Led by Detective Ye Jun, the Chinese Fox Hunt Team launches a high-stakes cross-border mission to recover the stolen assets and uncovers shocking secrets during the pursuit.

programme.title: Peg O My Heart
programme.desc: Psychiatrist Dr. Man begins treating night-shift taxi driver Choi, who is afraid to sleep and can no longer distinguish dreams from reality. During therapy, Dr. Man becomes haunted by his own disturbing and perplexing dreams. Are these night terrors the result of repressed memories, or the price of uncovering the ghosts hidden in Chois past?

programme.title: One and Only
programme.desc: Veteran street dancer Ding Lei, invites passionate street dancer, Chen Shuo to his dance club. Sparks fly when Chen dances with the clubs top dancers. Chen pursues his dream to perform but discovers that Ding has invited him for another reason. As both of them deal with hard times, can they turn the tide on the challenges that they are facing?

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dongs songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: The Wandering Swordsman
programme.desc: The wandering swordsman Yu Hsieh Erh has formidable sword skills and helps the poor by robbing from thieves and distributing the wealth. He meets a group of bandits who are planning to rob a convoy escorting some valuables and is tricked into participating in the robbery. Yu soon realizes his folly and returns to take revenge on the bandits.

programme.title: Dawn Will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parents consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her

programme.title: Dream of the Red Chamber1977
programme.desc: Adapted from the great Chinese classic novel of the same name, the son of renowned Jia family, Bao Yu, is deeply in love with his cousin, Dai Yu. However, his mother disapproves of their relationship and plots to arrange Bao Yu to marry another rich girl, resulting in a tragic ending for the perfect couple.

programme.title: Angel with the Iron Fists
programme.desc: Lo Wei directs and stars as the chief detective in this gripping thriller playing alongside Lily Ho, who excels in the role of an undercover avenger that can fight as well as she flirts! Caught between the crime bosses known as Baldhead and Black Widow, she only has four choices: punch, kick, shoot or bombard with explosives!

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer 1M for her baby...

programme.title: The Savage Five
programme.desc: A group of bandits flees with a stolen safe to a village where they oppress the villagers and force the blacksmith Wei to unlock the safe. Wei refuses and flees to report to officials, while heroes of the town emerge to fight the bandits.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxus enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the Deer Sword. Lians wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiaos home and he treats her poisonous wound. This leads Lian to suspect his wifes faithfulness and results in several blood-splattering duels with Xiao.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy familys daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his familys background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiance, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: The heroine Yu Fei Xia is accused of stealing the book of martial arts secrets. To prove her innocence, she disguises herself as a man and finds her way into the Shaolin Temple to find out the truth

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain mens life essence. With a Taoists help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: Accepted to the Golden Sword School after his father sacrificed his life to save his master, Fang Kang is resented by his fellow pupils and decides to leave. His masters daughter challenges him to a fight and cuts off his arm. Fang masters the art of sword fighting with one arm and finds himself returning to the School to save his master again.

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriends baby...

programme.title: The Treasure Hunters
programme.desc: An elite fortune hunter and a reckless young heir team up to search for a legendary pirate treasure. Their quest leads them to a remote monastery, where they must outwit a formidable Shaolin monk. However, when ruthless bandits close in, the unlikely allies must put aside their differences and fight side by side to survive.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular Venom Lo Meng.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as City Lights, is the directorwriters warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: The Twin Swords
programme.desc: Gui Wu and his wife Gan Lian Zhu are the famous Twin Swords in the martial arts world. One day, they stumble upon a kidnapping plot at the Red Lotus Temple and Lian Zhu is held captive. Wu successfully escapes to find the Gan family for help, not knowing that he is sending them into an ambush by the kidnappers. Can he finally save Lian Zhu?

programme.title: A Deadly Secret
programme.desc: A corrupt magistrate, obsessed with finding a hidden treasure, jails and tortures his daughters lover and buries his daughter alive! Ironically, it is in her coffin that the secret to the hidden treasure is found, setting off a frenzy of destruction.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: Perils Of The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Chu Liuxiang and the Eighth Prince stage a fake assassination attempt, allowing Chu to infiltrate Ghostly Manor as an undercover agent and eradicate this den of evil. The manor harbours notorious martial arts criminals and is rumoured to be haunted. Soon, during his investigation, Chu becomes entangled in a series of mysterious and eerie events.

programme.title: Hex vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Ambitious Kung Fu Girl
programme.desc: Si Si, a spoiled and naive rich girl with only basic kung fu training, becomes enchanted by the legends of the fearless hero Qin Ge. Determined to escape her fathers arranged marriage, she disguises herself as a man and sets out to find him, hoping to challenge Qin Geonly to be drawn into a deadly plot within the criminal underworld.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders, it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: One-armed Swordsman Fang Kang wants to lead a quiet life with his wife, but when she is abducted by the Eight Demon Swordsmen clan, he is forced to take them on in order to save her.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.
